name: servicenow-docs
description: The panes, hooks and commands of ServiceNow Docs in Claude Code: figures that explain a concept, the ServiceNow SDK panel, docs first for ServiceNow questions and a check of ServiceNow script code. The docs tools themselves come from the ServiceNow Docs extension of Claude Desktop; needs uv.

sdk_panel.title: ServiceNow SDK panel
sdk_panel.description: Adds /sdk-panel in Claude Code: a pane for the ServiceNow SDK command line (now-sdk) with setup, instances, commands and explain. It can run SDK commands, also against your instances, after you confirm each one. Turn it off for a plugin that only reads documentation.
